answer: Before first payout, the holder links a hiking association membership, its number and one signed trail record. Two verifiers match both against the log in a week; a trail claimed twice, or no fellow walker's signature, closes both. Joining costs a 2,000,000-rupiah guided walk, so one walker joins once while a thousand fakes need a thousand memberships and 2 billion. The walker rests beneath a willow and tells a fable of the wander.
